SalesOrders.title: Sales orders
SalesOrders.body: The bridge from order through delivery to invoice. Confirming freezes the allocation and posts nothing. A delivery note is created and issued; only issuing moves stock. The invoice arises from it as a draft in the documents area, where it is reviewed and issued. Backorders have their own filter: ordered quantities not yet delivered.
